title: Shared source pantry and proposed game dependency library

count_definitions.source_occurrences: Indexed ingredient entries in recipes plus ingredient-catalog records. A supplied range can group repeated mentions; the two layers can repeat evidence. This is not a census of every lexical occurrence in novel text.
count_definitions.components_total: All preserved book-local formulas plus shared authored defaults, including defaults available for reuse.
count_definitions.recipes: Book-qualified food/serving candidates, including source-only and discourse records; not a count of runtime-active recipes.

policy.canonical_source: Source mentions are immutable attributed evidence, not statements that every recipe was cooked or every botanical is safe. Source spellings are only normalized typographically.
policy.game_only: All semantic equivalences, generic selections and compound completions apply only to the game layer and carry explicit authored provenance.
policy.component_resolution: Book-local formula first; shared fallback second; declared leaf third; otherwise UNKNOWN and blocked.
policy.greensap: Outcast evidence may establish plant derivation for specific preparations. It does not establish plant origin for every unnamed milk/cream/cheese in every book. Shared oat greensap is an authored variant.
policy.production_eligibility: production_candidate defaults true only where the book omits that field; explicit false is preserved. Optional raw authored game inputs in a false row do not grant production eligibility. Shared normalized recipes clear their active-facing label/method for false rows; pantry preserves raw proposal evidence.
policy.runtime_gate: No quantities, yield, labor, nutrition, unlocks, market prices or time constants are activated. Narrative numbers do not fill these fields.
policy.reference_key: Always use book key plus local record ID; book prefixes are not globally unique. Join shared recipes by (book_key, local_id) == (pantry book, book_recipe_id), or use shared_recipe_id. Pantry id is retained separately. Consume precomputed game_inputs.target_kind/target_id; label-based lookup must first apply game_only_normalization_map and preserve book_term. Never fuzzy-match source names.

canonical_source_terms.semantic_merge_policy: Only case, Unicode apostrophe and whitespace normalization; botanical, food-origin and recipe-equivalence claims are not inferred.

source_locators.text: Rub arrowroot and pollen flour together while slowly adding greensap milk; add flaked beechnuts and dried plums, reserve some beechnuts. Dust dish with pollen flour and arrange honeyed damsons alternating with raspberries in rows.

Bake and cool until firm, then cut lengthways three times into four layers. Bottom: rosehip syrup and sugared violets. Second: blackberry cream and crystallized maple leaves. game_components.label: maple sauce

game_components.label: onion sauce

game_components.label: plum preserve

game_components.label: shortbread biscuit

game_components.label: wholemeal bread

game_components.label: dandelion fizz

game_components.label: chopped raspberry

game_components.label: cooked apple

game_components.label: prepared cabbage leaf
game_components.method: Separate whole edible cabbage leaves, soften them in water and drain for wrapping a game filling.

game_components.label: prepared onion layer
game_components.method: Remove the dry outer onion covering and separate intact edible onion layers as game wrappers. This authored state interprets the source skin phrase without asserting that dry skins are an edible wrapper.

game_components.label: prepared hazelnut
game_components.method: Remove the hazelnut shell and separate the edible game kernel as a prepared input.

game_components.label: dandelion cordial
game_components.method: Infuse cultivated game dandelion petals in water, strain and sweeten with honey; this is an unfermented cordial with no medical effect.

game_components.label: apple preserve
game_components.method: Core the apples, chop the edible fruit and cook with water and honey; add apple pectin to represent a game preserve, with no real storage claim.

game_components.label: greengage preserve
game_components.method: Remove greengage pits, cook the fruit with water and honey, then add apple pectin to represent a game preserve; no real storage claim.

game_components.label: rosehip vinegar
game_components.method: Press prepared rosehip pulp with water, add honey and the fermentation culture, then run a separate vinegar-culture game job; strain the finished game vinegar. No durations or acidity values are asserted.

game_components.label: wheat cake
game_components.method: Mix wheat flour, oat drink, hazelnut oil, honey and the selected starter into a sweet batter, allow its game proofing stage, bake and cool before cutting into trifle pieces.

game_components.label: vegetable sausage
game_components.method: Grind barley and oats, finely chop carrot and mushroom and combine them into a moist filling. Enclose the filling in prepared edible onion layers and bake the parcels. This game component follows the declared Didjety game selection; grain form and edible onion-layer interpretation are authored choices.

Gift wine explicitly elderberry/plum dark sweet old southland wine, age claimed by Swartt; Wurgg/Bowfleg consume but POISON ON CUP, not wine (322–398). Garden leek,onion,potato,turnip,peas,cabbage; plum/apple/pear trees, horse chestnuts nearby; later redcurrant/blackberry/raspberry/strawberry expected; button mushrooms (412–420). Horse chestnut presence does NOT prove edible chestnut identity. Apple-blackberry pie; summer salad,new cheese,oatfarls (427–439). IMPORTANT cheese434 explicitly plant-derived greensap milk from pounded fat white grass stems and unspecified special tubers, plus hazel/almond/chestnut; autumn gathering, winter maturation, damp crack-willow bark protective wrap, no rind,pale yellow,almond scent; greased twine cuts oval slices (434–438).
